blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ saying, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I do not like my wife to see my private parts." "Why is that so?' asked Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) replied, "Because I feel shy and I dislike it." Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "Allaah has made her your garment and made you hers. At times my wives see my private parts and I see theirs. "You do that, O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) asked in surprise. When Rasulullaah ﷺ confirmed that this was indeed so, Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) said, "Who can there be after you (for me to follow)?" After he had left, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Verily Ibn Madh'oon (RA) is extremely bashful and one who always keeps his private area concealed."[^1]
The Modesty of Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA)
Hadhrat Abu Mijlaz reports that Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) said, "I bath in a dark room and do not stand up straight until I have picked up my clothes. This I do out of shyness for my Rabb."[^2]

Hadhrat Abu Qataadah (RA) states that when Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) took a bath, he would do so in a dark room (sitting down) and bend over when getting his clothing without standing up straight.[^3]
Hadhrat Anas (RA) says that Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) always wore some clothing when sleeping for fear of his private area becoming exposed.[^4]

Hadhrat Ubaadah bin Nusay reports that Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) once saw some people standing in water without their lower garments. To this, he exclaimed, "I prefer to die and be raised again, then to die and be raised again and again to die and be raised again rather than doing what these people are doing."[^5]
The Modesty of Hadhrat Ashaj Abdul Qais (RA)

Hadhrat Ashaj Abdul Qais (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to him, "You have two qualities that Allaah loves." When he asked what they were, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Tolerance and modesty." Hadhrat Ashaj (RA) asked further, "Are these natural qualities within me or have they been developed afterwards?" "No," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ, "They have been naturally instilled within you." Hadhrat Ashaj (RA) then said, "All praise is for Allaah Who has instilled within me such qualities that He loves."[^6]
